About ›

Question-based learning is one of the most effective study strategies in medical education. Actively retrieving information strengthens memory far more than re-reading alone — a phenomenon known as the testing effect.

GIT is designed to complement your lectures and scriptum, not replace them. Use it after covering a topic to consolidate understanding, identify gaps, and build clinical reasoning under exam-like conditions.

Immediate feedback with explanations after every answer helps you correct misconceptions in real time — making each mistake a learning opportunity.
